name: Catherine Jereza
current_role: Assistant Secretary of Energy for Electricity (since October 2025)
summary: Catherine Jereza heads the Energy Department’s Office of Electricity, which works on grid reliability and transmission; the Senate Energy Committee advanced her nomination in 2025 over Democratic objections, and she took office in October 2025.
